lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Ingredient sources: Farmer gives crops, grains, vegetables, and flour. Fisherman gives fish.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Dairy Farmer gives milk, butter, cheese, spoiled milk, and other dairy nightmares.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Butcher gives livestock, meat, chicken, and rotten meat. Charming fellow. Very knife-forward.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Insect & Poultry Keeper gives insects and small poultry ingredients, excluding chickens.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Bread: collect flour from the Farmer, then bake it at the Baking station.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Vegetable Soup: collect vegetables from the Farmer and chicken from the Butcher. Slice both, grill them, then assemble.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Cream Soup: collect spoiled milk from the Dairy Farmer, heat it at the Grilling station, then assemble.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Meat Stew: collect rotten meat from the Butcher, slice it, grill it, then assemble.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Meat Pie: collect meat from the Butcher and flour from the Farmer. Slice the meat, bake, then assemble.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Fish Pie: collect fish from the Fisherman and flour from the Farmer. Slice the fish, bake, then assemble.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Mold Toast: collect flour from the Farmer, bake bread, collect moldy cheese from the Dairy Farmer, then toast at the Grilling station.

lines.speaker: Recipe Guide
lines.text: Flutter Chicken: collect chicken from the Butcher and butterflies from the Insect & Poultry Keeper. Grill chicken, then assemble.

lines.speaker: Creature
lines.text: Now cook. The countdown dislikes students.
